description: This file defines a custom RecyclerView ItemDecoration class used to add horizontal spacing between items in a RecyclerView, with configurable start, between-item, and end paddings.

classes.name: HorizontalSpaceItemDecoration
classes.description: A RecyclerView ItemDecoration that adds configurable horizontal spacing around RecyclerView items.

methods.name: getItemOffsets
methods.description: Overrides RecyclerView.ItemDecoration.getItemOffsets to set left, right, top, bottom offsets for each item, adding spaces and paddings as specified.
